name: Frostable Warriors
description: Masters of resilience, Frostable Warriors win by still being standing.
strength: High endurance and resistance to damage over time.
weakness: Lower burst damage than any other supremacy.

name: Keiknight Warriors
description: Versatile fighters who blend offence and defence without a glaring seam.
strength: Effective attacking and defending, with no significant drawback.
weakness: Predictable. Can be outmatched by a specialist.

name: Keikdark Lords
description: Masters of dark arts and soul manipulation. Fearsome and unpredictable.
strength: Soul abilities come faster and cost less to reach.
weakness: Takes increased damage from light. Volatile under pressure.

name: Elemental Keik Master
description: Commanders of a chosen element, at their most dangerous on home ground.
strength: Draws more from elemental advantage than anyone else.
weakness: Ordinary when the matchup is neutral.

name: Soulfeast Keik Overlord
description: A terrifying thing that consumes souls to fuel its own dark power.
strength: Devastating attacks that grow with every soul spent.
weakness: Thin guard. Punishing to play badly.

name: Divine Keiknities
description: God-like beings who command a fundamental force of existence.
strength: No weak stat. Reads the arena better than anything else alive.
weakness: Rare enough that everyone has prepared for you.
